records.name: Ironward Company
records.introduction: Captain Sera offers a place beside the city's roadwardens. 'Bring our people home.'

quests.title: The Silent Patrol
quests.briefing: Recover the missing patrol's supply satchel in Barren Plains.
quests.completionText: Beneath a broken cart you find the patrol's supplies and a scout's map leading to Shadowed Grove.

quests.title: Tracks in the Grove
quests.briefing: Confront the Goblin Scout in Shadowed Grove and secure the patrol's escape route.
quests.completionText: The scout falls. The surviving wardens emerge from hiding, ready to return to Attania.

records.name: Lantern Scholars
records.introduction: Archivist Iven welcomes curious minds. 'A lost page can be more dangerous than a drawn blade.'

quests.title: Scattered Pages
quests.briefing: Retrieve the scholar's research from Enchanted Forest.
quests.completionText: You gather rain-stained pages beneath a hollow tree. Their diagrams point to Enchanted Library.

quests.title: The Unquiet Archive
quests.briefing: Defeat the Bonewalker guarding the missing folio in Enchanted Library.
quests.completionText: The guardian crumbles, revealing the folio that completes the scholars' research.

records.name: Silverthread Consortium
records.introduction: Factor Mirelle studies your hands. 'Honest work pays. Finding what was stolen pays better.'

quests.title: An Unbalanced Ledger
quests.briefing: Recover the stolen shipping ledger hidden in Ghost Town.
quests.completionText: A ledger lies under a loose floorboard. False entries reveal a shipment diverted to Bandit Hideout.

quests.title: The Last Delivery
quests.briefing: Confront the Outlaw in Bandit Hideout and reclaim the stolen merchandise.
quests.completionText: Behind the outlaw's barricade you find the missing cargo, still bearing Trisselie's silver seals.

records.name: Crownward Order
records.introduction: Warden Alis lowers her voice. 'Service to the crown begins with keeping a promise.'

quests.title: A Courier's Promise
quests.briefing: Find the missing courier's dispatch in Whispering Woods.
quests.completionText: The wounded courier entrusts you with a dispatch: raiders carried the royal seal to Abandoned Castle.

quests.title: The Stolen Seal
quests.briefing: Defeat the Goblin Marauder at Abandoned Castle and retrieve the royal seal.
quests.completionText: The marauder drops a velvet case. The royal seal inside will restore trust in the capital's messengers.

records.name: Tidebound Fellowship
records.introduction: Navigator Oren spreads a weathered chart. 'Every lost voyage deserves someone to follow its wake.'

quests.title: Beyond the Last Chart
quests.briefing: Find the expedition's journal at Desert Oasis.
quests.completionText: The expedition sheltered here. Its journal marks a relic cache deep in Crystal Caverns.

quests.title: A Treasure with Teeth
quests.briefing: Defeat the Mimic concealing the expedition's relic in Crystal Caverns.
quests.completionText: The false chest collapses. You recover the expedition's tideglass relic from its splintered remains.
